product_metadata.title: Mayim Large Travel Coffee Mug Tumbler with Clear Slide Lid and Handle, Reusable Vacuum Insulated Double-Wall Stainless-Steel Thermos, Fits in Cup Holder, 30oz, Fuchsia
features: THERMAL INSULATED TUMBLER: Enjoy a beverage on the go with our 30-ounce reusable travel coffee mug. This tumbler features a convenient handle and a flip lid for easy sipping. It keeps water cold for 24 hours and coffee hot for 9 hours for all-day refreshment!

DOUBLE-WALL CONSTRUCTION: This modern mug tumbler features a double-walled construction that helps liquids stay cold or hot for hours. The premium design protects against sweat and condensation, and the rubber-coat finish makes this mug safe and easy to bring with you outdoors.

HIGH-QUALITY TRAVEL CUP: Our large insulated coffee mug is designed to fit simply and easily inside your cup holder. The wide-mouthed, leak-proof cap and easy-carry handle help prevent spills, so you can trust this durable 30-ounce tumbler to get you through your day wherever you go.

EASY-CARE STAINLESS STEEL MUG: This big portable tumbler helps you stand out. With a built-in carry handle, it’s easy to carry to work, to the gym, around your home, or as you run errands. To wash, simply remove the lid and handwash both pieces in the sink.

THE PERFECT GIFT: Give this insulated mug to anyone in your life who is on the go and wants to stand out from the crowd. This classic tumbler is a perfect gift for a fitness or travel lover, or you can buy it for yourself as a brand-new drinking cup.
description: Need a way to keep your beverage cold or hot throughout the day? Mayim introduces our handy, reusable large-capacity stainless-steel coffee mug with handle, a stylish matte cup that stands out from other bottles. This big tumbler holds 30 oz. of water or coffee so you can hydrate or stay energized throughout the day. Plus, it’s equipped with a leak-proof flip cap and an easy-carry handle, adding extra spill protection. The rubber and powder-coated exterior finish helps protect against sweat, and the wide-mouthed lid makes it simple to add ice or quickly clean your bottle. With its double-wall vacuum construction, this insulated cup helps keep your drink hot or cool for any adventure you go on.This sturdy, tall mug can withstand daily use as you travel or exercise, so you can reuse it again and again. Wrap it up to give to your loved ones as a fun way for them to stay hydrated and energized while expressing their style, or pick one out for yourself for a handy mug while you’re on the go. Find the cup you’ll love with our array of reusable tumbler options!To wash your lightweight tumbler, remove the lid to clean the inside of the cup. Wash the cup by hand in a sink, and let it dry before the next use. Do not put this item in the dishwasher or in the microwave.At Mayim, we believe in products with a purpose. Our mission is to eliminate the supply of single-use plastic, one bottle at a time. All of our exclusive products are made to be reusable and affordable. We’re committed to making it easier for parents like you to encourage your kids to be more green, starting with the water bottle they carry to school, dance, basketball practice, and more.
